archimate:ApplicationComponent.name: Spatial API
archimate:ApplicationComponent.documentation: Core spatial data API enabling applications (TMS, Site Explorer, HIF) to read and write spatial geometries and attributes stored in spatial databases.

properties.value: Uses Azure Relay Bridge (azbridge) to connect across network boundaries to databases outside CHS.
On-premises Postgres (gilgamesh for Test, greenwich for Live/Preprod) and Oracle Database.
